name: Care plan drafting assistant
description: Drafts a care plan for an adult from a social worker's case notes using generative AI.

name: Meeting notes summariser
description: Summarises the audio of internal team meetings into notes for staff.

name: Bin collection chatbot
description: Answers resident questions about bin collection days on the website.

name: Children's referral triage
description: Prioritises referrals about children for a safeguarding team using a risk score.

name: Housing demand analytics
description: Produces anonymised aggregate forecasts of housing demand for planners. No personal data is used.

name: Benefit eligibility checker
description: Assesses whether a household is eligible for a council tax reduction and recommends an outcome. A member of staff reviews every decision.

name: Planning application summary
description: Summarises long planning applications for case officers.

name: Homelessness risk predictor
description: Predicts the risk of homelessness for residents so that support can be offered early.

name: Customer services email triage
description: Reads incoming emails from residents and routes them to the right team automatically.

name: Policy document search
description: A search tool that finds policy documents for staff. Internal use only.

name: SEND plan review assistant
description: Helps officers review education health and care plans for children with special educational needs and drafts review letters.

name: Fleet route optimiser
description: Plans the most efficient routes for council vehicles.

name: Complaint classifier
description: Classifies complaints from residents by theme and urgency.

name: Fostering matching tool
description: Recommends fostering placements for looked-after children based on case records.

name: Social media monitor
description: Reports trends in public posts about council services using aggregate statistics.

name: Staff HR query bot
description: Answers staff questions about leave and pay. It sends the employee a message with the policy link.

name: Parking permit checker
description: Automatically approves or refuses resident parking permits using address records.

name: Translation assistant
description: Translates letters into other languages for service users. Reviewed by a member of staff before sending.

name: Adult safeguarding alert reader
description: Reads safeguarding alerts about vulnerable adults and recommends which need urgent action.

name: Library recommendation helper
description: Suggests books to library members.

name: Case notes summariser
description: Summarises case notes in a social care record for the next worker.

name: Road defect image detector
description: Finds potholes in photographs taken from vehicles.

name: School admissions allocator
description: Decides which school place is offered to each child from application data.

name: Finance invoice reader
description: Reads supplier invoices and enters the data into the finance system automatically.

name: Mental health referral assistant
description: Drafts a referral summary from a client's health records for a mental health team.

name: Website accessibility checker
description: Checks web pages for accessibility problems.

name: Elections mailing writer
description: Drafts polling card reminder letters for residents.

name: Care home quality scorer
description: Scores care homes from inspection reports using generative summaries.

name: Early help predictor
description: Predicts which families with children may need early help from past case data.

name: Energy use dashboard
description: A dashboard of energy use in council buildings. Reporting only.

name: Voice assistant for care calls
description: Answers telephone calls from carers and updates the client record.

name: Grant application scorer
description: Scores grant applications from community groups and recommends which to fund.

name: Noise complaint router
description: Sends noise complaints to the right environmental health officer.

name: Pupil attendance predictor
description: Predicts which pupils are at risk of persistent absence.

name: Staff rota helper
description: Suggests shift rotas for care staff. A manager approves the final rota.

name: Press release drafter
description: Drafts press releases for the communications team.
